photos.desc: Fry of Mexican dwarf crayfish ( Cambarellus patzcuarensis ), about one week old. The diameter of the cup is 8.9 centimetres (approximately 3.5 inches).
A male orange-coloured mutation of Mexican dwarf crayfish, Cambarellus patzcuarensis var. "Orange". In the background there is some Pogostemon helferi.
